The '''1974–75 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 39th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 29 September 1974 and ended on 8 June 1975. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their third consecutive and 20th Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
